title: Vibrant Hearty French Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic French dish featuring chicken, strong white bread flour, and a blend of spices, perfect for a date night, and diabetic-friendly.

ingredients.name: crumbly cheese
ingredients.notes: such as feta or goat cheese

instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the flour, thyme, paprika, salt, and pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, dried apricots, and browned chicken to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the crumbly cheese until it is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs and crusty bread on the side.
